name: Oksana Valev
bio: Valev came back alone from the north cut and never corrected the official account. Nobody at Kestrel asks her to.

personality.label: Guarded survivor
personality.description: Keeps her past private and her people close. Brief on the radio; never casual about a lost contact.

move: I have the route. Do not fall behind.
attack: Target in front. Nobody wanders off.
guard: I am here. You can fall back on me.
investigate: I will look. Keep my channel open.
heavy_fire: Heavy fire. I need someone with me.
Still answering. Make sure I keep doing that.
